summary: Verified the Admin Console unified-topbar + SPA-nav fix. All 4 pills (Overview/Students/Colleges/Content) now navigate via react-router Link without full page reload (window.__spaMarker survived every click, no login-screen flash). Overview page shares the exact same Topbar as the other 3 pages. Logo (admin-topbar-home) returns to /admin via SPA; admin-logout-button signs out correctly; login works. Overdue alert card, stat cards, charts, and tabs all render on Overview. Found and fixed one regression triggered by the SPA-cache behavior: ContentPage crashed with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading contact)' when navigating to /admin/content via SPA because the content cache was hot while the local draft state was still null on first render — ErrorBoundary showed 'Something went wrong. Please refresh.' Fixed by extending the loading guard to also wait for draft to be hydrated.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx still contains large duplicated constants (STATUSES, COLLEGES, STATUS_STYLE, STATUS_LABEL, initials, fmtDate, waLink) that are already exported from lib/admin.js — remove duplicates and import from the shared module.
AdminPage.jsx is 704 lines — consider splitting DetailModal, PaymentCell, EnquiryDeleteButton and the Applications/Enquiries tabs into separate files.

ContentPage.jsx: initial draft hydration was race-prone; after the fix a null-draft guard was added but consider also using optional chaining (draft?.contact?.name) or deriving `draft` with useMemo to avoid stale state across content refetches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA navigation across all 4 admin console pills is verified. ContentPage had a race-condition crash when navigated-to via SPA (content cache hot, draft still null) — fixed by waiting for draft in the loading guard (ContentPage.jsx line ~192). Overdue alert, stat cards and charts render on Overview. Backend not re-tested this iteration; previous iterations cover backend.
rca of the issue: ContentPage crash RCA: useContentStrict() returns the cached /api/content payload synchronously if already fetched. On SPA navigation to /admin/content with warm cache, `content` was truthy on the first render but the local `draft` state (initialized to null, set inside a useEffect) had not been hydrated yet. The JSX accessed draft.contact.name directly → TypeError → ErrorBoundary. Repro: 1) login, 2) click any other pill first (warms /api/content via shared Topbar? actually warmed by any page using useContentStrict), 3) click Site Content pill — crash. Mitigation applied: expanded loading guard from `if (!content)` to `if (!content || !draft)` so first render after mount shows the loading state until the useEffect hydrates draft.
